title: nginx reverse proxy
description: proxy01/02 behind proxy-vip: published sites, TLS certificate, traffic per site, connections, probes and logs.

panels.title: VIP on
panels.description: The proxy holding keepalived's VIP proxy-vip (10.2.11.107): every published name is a CNAME to it. The other one is the standby.

panels.title: nginx
panels.description: nginx answering its exporter (stub_status) on each proxy. keepalived moves the VIP away from a proxy whose /healthz fails.

panels.title: Sites (HTTPS through the proxy)
panels.description: Blackbox probes from mon01/02 of each published site by name: DNS, the VIP, TLS with a valid certificate and a 2xx from the backend. Alert: ProbeFailed.

panels.title: Certificate expires in
panels.description: The wildcard *.lylat.space as the sites serve it (Let's Encrypt, roots/certs). It renews itself at ~30 days left. Orange under 14 days (alert TLSCertExpiringSoon), red under 3.

panels.title: Certificate
panels.description: Subject and issuer of the leaf certificate.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Both proxies, every request including keepalived's /healthz checks (stub_status counts all).

panels.title: Active connections
panels.description: Open client connections on both proxies (reading + writing + idle keep-alive).

panels.title: Errors in range (5xx)
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx (502/504 = the backend VIP didn't answer).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | status >= 500 [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__=""  [$__range]))

panels.title: Requests in range
panels.description: Requests to the published sites in the time range (access log; /healthz isn't logged).

defaults.noValue: No access lines in range (log_format lylat, services-config proxy-nginx.conf)

panels.title: Requests by site
panels.description: Requests per published name (the Host header; scanners asking for the bare IP show up as that).

defaults.noValue: No access lines in range (log_format lylat, services-config proxy-nginx.conf)

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Responses per status class: 3xx are mostly the http->https redirects and Grafana's login redirect.

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Request time p95 by site
panels.description: $request_time: first byte from the client to the last byte sent. Long-polling and websockets (Grafana live) show their whole duration.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | rt != "" | rt != "-" | unwrap rt | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (vhost)

defaults.noValue: No access lines in range (log_format lylat, services-config proxy-nginx.conf)

panels.title: Upstream time p95 by site
panels.description: $upstream_response_time: how long the backend VIP (grafana-vip, netbox-vip, dark-triage-vip) took. The difference to the request time is the client side.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | urt != "" | urt != "-" | unwrap urt | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (vhost)

defaults.noValue: No access lines in range (log_format lylat, services-config proxy-nginx.conf)

panels.title: Sites in range
panels.description: Per published name over the time range, from the access log.

targets.expr: sum by (vhost) (count_over_time({host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | status >= 200 | status < 300 [$__range]))
sum by (vhost) (count_over_time({host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | status >= 400 | status < 500 [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | rt != "" | rt != "-" | unwrap rt | __error__="" [$__range]) by (vhost)
sum by (vhost) (sum_over_time({host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__="" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No access lines in range (log_format lylat, services-config proxy-nginx.conf)

panels.title: Top paths
panels.description: Most requested paths over the time range.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (vhost, uri) (count_over_time({host=~"proxy[0-9]+", app="nginx"} |= "vhost=" | logfmt | __error__=""  [$__range]))))

panels.title: Top clients
panels.description: Client addresses over the time range.

panels.title: Failed requests (4xx/5xx)
panels.description: Requests answered with an error. 502/504: nginx couldn't reach the backend VIP.

panels.title: Requests/s by proxy
panels.description: The VIP holder takes the client traffic; both answer keepalived's and the exporter's checks.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: reading: receiving the request; writing: proxying/sending the response (websockets stay here); idle: keep-alive connections waiting for the next request.

panels.title: Connections accepted / dropped
panels.description: Dropped = accepted but not handled: worker_connections (1024) exhausted.

panels.title: Probe time by site
panels.description: The whole HTTPS request from mon01/02: DNS, TCP and TLS to the VIP, nginx and the backend.

panels.title: Probe phases (all sites)
panels.description: resolve: DNS (dns-vip); connect: TCP to proxy-vip; tls: handshake; processing: nginx plus the backend until the first byte; transfer: the body.

panels.title: Network (rx + tx)
panels.description: All physical NICs: management, VLAN 2 (clients and backends) and VLAN 220 (keepalived).

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node", role="proxy", device=~"e.*"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node", role="proxy", device=~"e.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8

panels.title: VIP moves
panels.description: keepalived taking over the VIP: a deploy that restarts nginx, a failed health check or a reboot.

panels.title: nginx error log
panels.description: nginx's own messages (warnings, upstream errors, reloads). The container logs them on stderr, so Loki's level says error for all of them; the [level] in the text is the real one.

panels.title: keepalived
panels.description: VRRP state changes and health-check results on both proxies.
